in_text_mentions: in bronchial washings and mucosal biopsy from anthracotic deposits in lungs. In view of undiagnosed exudative left sided pleural effusion, semi-rigid pleurovideoscopy was done, which revealed diffuse black coloured deposits over visceral pleura and focally scattered deposits over parietal pleura (Figures 3(a) and 3(b)). Pleural biopsy from pigmented lesions of parietal pleura was obtained. Microscopic findings of biopsy revealed nodular aggregates of macrophages with anthracotic pigment; no granulomas were seen. Histopathological examination was consistent with Pleural Anthracosis (Figure 4).
